_readme: The homepage 'Trusted by' logo strip. Placeholders until real, approved client logos are supplied: only list an organization with its written permission. Each entry: id (stable), name (the organization; screen readers read it), logo (optional: a path to its logo file, ideally a single-colour SVG in assets/icons/clients/; shown in monochrome), show (false keeps an entry here without showing it). Placeholders without a logo render as a typographic mark: mark sets the glyph (circle, square, diamond, ring, bars, none) and style the lettering (caps, wide, bold, light). To use a real logo: set name and logo, delete mark and style, then node tools/build.mjs. Two logo files are already in assets/images/ (aim.png: Asian Institute of Management, cce.png: The University of Sydney); they are listed below with show: false until their use is approved.
label: Trusted by teams and institutions
